name: Bell Channel Club & Marina
brand_truth: A quiet gated club between the canal and the beach, right where the inlet opens into Port Lucaya.
buyer: Owners and their guests, prospective buyers and renters, captains of visiting boats; mostly US/Canada, mostly on phones.
big_idea: Scrolling carries you across open water off Lucaya at dusk toward the island and the breakwater lights of Bell Channel, with real waypoints as film subtitles, ending on the bay inside the cut.

direction.why: Quiet luxury suits a private owners' club; the real-time scene carries the page so the type can stay sparse.

concept_type: brochure: club and private owners' marina, who-is-asking router, slip note + call

images.credit: stills rendered from the site's own 3D scene
Lovable asset studio (Nov 8), illustrative, replace with the club's own

current_site_findings: bellchannelclub.com now serves a gambling site
only an unclaimed marinas.com listing with no photos or dock details
nothing says the marina is private and for owners
amenities known only from scattered realtor listings
only phone and fax from old directories
pitch_line: Your old domain sends owners and buyers to a gambling site. This is what Bell Channel Club looks like when someone arrives from the sea.
assumptions: Slip limits, depth, power, fuel and VHF are unknown: shown as 'Confirmed when you call'
Coordinates from the marinas.com map pin
Generated photographs are illustrative, not the club
The 3D island silhouette, buildings and breakwater lights are an evocation, not a survey of the real channel
